summary: Append another Blob's immutable bytes without string coercion.

semantics.source_type: does not automatically become result type

caveats: The nested Blob's MIME type is not concatenated into the outer type.

tests.name: bytes reused logically
tests.input: const x=new Blob(['a'],{type:'text/plain'}); const y=new Blob([x]); console.log(y.size,y.type==='')
